description: Get tide predictions for a NOAA station — high/low tides, hourly, or 6-minute intervals. Returns predicted water level in feet or meters. Covers US coastlines, rivers, Great Lakes. Station IDs: 8518750 (NYC), 9414290 (SF), 8443970 (Boston) (NOAA, US Gov)

datum.description: Vertical datum: MLLW (default), MSL, NAVD, MHHW, MHW, MLW, etc.

end_date.description: End date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g. "20260410"). Max range: 31 days.

interval.description: Prediction interval: "hilo" = high/low tides only (default), "h" = hourly, "6" = every 6 minutes

station.description: NOAA station ID (e.g. "8518750" for The Battery NYC, "9414290" for San Francisco, "8443970" for Boston)

name: tides.noaa.predictions

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Tide Predictions
